يبتعثان (form VIII)

# يُبْتَعَثَانِ (yubtaʕaṯāni) /jub.ta.ʕa.θaː.ni/: third-person masculine dual non-past passive indicative of اِبْتَعَثَ (ibtaʕaṯa)
